All twenty-three spoken lines and six player choices were reviewed for art terminology, physical humor, character voice, diplomatic reactions, Lupini reference, creative encouragement, and relationship context. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quick-question branch counts, mail and special-order state, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batches, all Forest records are covered; the full-locale final audits remain pending.
